_readme: The FOURTH PriceList, as it will be submitted to the price topic 0.0.10426551.
It is sequence 3 with ONE field changed: provisioning.unitPrice, from "2" to "30". §14.3
makes the schedule the SEQUENCE of messages and the price current at a purchase the latest
message before it, so this supersedes sequence 3 by landing after it, and sequences 1, 2 and
3 are not edited.
WHY IT CHANGED, AND IT IS ABOUT COST RATHER THAN ABOUT MARGIN. Sequence 2 priced the
provisioned path at 2 ℏ, and sequence 3 carried that number forward untouched. Both were
written before a HIP-991 fee-gated topic had ever been created on this network, so the 2 ℏ
was an estimate of a cost nobody had paid. Gate One paid it: one mailbox costs the Postmaster
27.78102934 ℏ across its eight rows, of which the fee-gated doorbell alone is 26.31542199 ℏ.
The Postmaster was selling at 2 ℏ a thing that costs it 27.78 ℏ.
Sequence 4 prices it at 30 ℏ — roughly eight percent over the measured cost, which is what
absorbs ordinary movement in the exchange rate between one purchase and the next. Hedera's
fee schedule is USD-denominated and charged in ℏ, so the cost this recovers is not a constant
and a flat ℏ price cannot track it exactly. See ledger §G-20: pricing the provisioned path by
reference to another asset is what methods[] already does and what provisioning cannot do,
because the registered schema gives provisioning exactly {method, unitPrice, registrationFee}
and §1.7 has fired. That is a 0.6 candidate and is not coded around here.
registrationFee is UNCHANGED at 0.05 ℏ. It is not a margin and not a fee we set: it is the ℏ
the purchase funds into the agent's own account so the agent can pay for its own registration
submission (§4.6, D-159's addendum), and the measurement above did not move it.
WHAT DOES NOT CHANGE, AND WHAT A READER SHOULD CHECK. Correspondent B bought under sequence 3
and is never repriced: §14.3 fixes the price at the message current at the purchase, and a
receipt is never reconstructed by the party that charged it. Everything else here is sequence
3's, byte for byte — the same stampToken, the same payTo, the same bundles, the same methods,
and the same hbar rate source, which is the network's own exchange rate a Verifier can
re-obtain at a receipt's rate.at (D-170). The runner asserts that: it fetches sequence 3 from
the mirror and refuses to submit unless the diff is exactly one leaf.
spec is 0.5.10 because that is the text this message is published under. The specification did
not move; the deployment did. _readme is stripped before canonicalization, exactly as it is
for sequences 1, 2 and 3.
